heroSubheading: We stock everything you need for outdoor power equipment.
aboutHtml:
Craig Walker has owned STIHL SHOP Kumeu since 2015. We stock quality outdoor power equipment from STIHL, Masport, Rover, Cub Cadet, Honda and Hustler. We're here to help you find what you need, with the expertise and support to back it up.

We offer onsite demonstrations so you can see equipment in action. Our workshop handles servicing and repairs for everything we sell, and we stock genuine spare parts. Shop with us in-store or online with Click and Collect or direct home delivery to your door.

We're part of the Kumeu community, supporting the Volunteer Fire Brigade and sponsoring local rugby and bowling clubs. Come in during the week or weekend to chat with us about your outdoor power needs. We're here to give advice, show you what we've got, or service your existing equipment.
